title: Vodka and gin
lead: Vodka is the clean slate; gin is vodka’s cousin with juniper. Learn the legal kinds of gin and the styles on our back bar.

read.bigIdea: Vodka is meant to be clean and neutral.
read.where: Vodka can be made from **any farm base**: wheat, rye, corn, potatoes, even grapes. It is distilled to a high strength and usually **not aged**, so it tastes clean. In the EU it is bottled at **37.5% or more**. **Flavored vodkas** add fruit, citrus or vanilla.

keyPoints.line: like coriander and citrus peel build around it.
is a method: nothing but water added after distilling.

read.where: Gin is a spirit flavored with **juniper**, and juniper has to lead. Other **botanicals** (coriander, citrus peel, angelica root and more) build around it. EU law has three kinds. **Gin**: juniper flavor added to neutral spirit. **Distilled gin**: redistilled with the botanicals. **London gin**: every flavor comes from that distillation; afterward only water and a tiny amount of sugar (0.1 g per liter) may go in, and no color.
read.mixup: **London Dry** is a method, not a place: it can be made anywhere.

keyPoints.line: is made from malt wine, so it’s malty.
is a liqueur made with sloe berries.

read.bigIdea: Five styles of gin, from dry to malty.
read.where: **London Dry** is crisp and juniper-forward. **Plymouth** comes from Plymouth, England. **Old Tom** is a softer, sweeter style. **Genever**, from the Netherlands and Belgium, is made from **malt wine**, so it tastes malty, a little like whiskey. **Contemporary** gins keep juniper but let other botanicals lead. **Sloe gin** is a liqueur: gin with sloe berries, at least 25% ABV.

read.bigIdea: Most of the classics start with gin.
read.where: Gin is the base of the **Martini**, **Negroni** (gin, Campari, sweet vermouth), **Gimlet** (gin and lime), **Tom Collins** (gin, lemon, sugar and soda), **French 75** (gin, lemon and sugar topped with Champagne) and the **Gin and Tonic**. A **dry** gin keeps a Martini crisp.
read.sayIt: It’s gin-based: bright, botanical and dry.
